# PartitionedBuffer v0.4.2 - Table of Contents

ETS-based partitioned buffer for high-throughput data processing

## Modules

- [PartitionedBuffer](https://partitioned-buffer.hexdocs.pm/PartitionedBuffer.md): ETS-based partitioned buffer for high-throughput data processing.
- [PartitionedBuffer.Partition](https://partitioned-buffer.hexdocs.pm/PartitionedBuffer.Partition.md): Buffer partition.

- Buffer implementations
  - [PartitionedBuffer.Map](https://partitioned-buffer.hexdocs.pm/PartitionedBuffer.Map.md): ETS-based partitioned map buffer for high-throughput key-value data processing.
  - [PartitionedBuffer.Queue](https://partitioned-buffer.hexdocs.pm/PartitionedBuffer.Queue.md): ETS-based partitioned queue buffer for high-throughput data processing.
